advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Wrap the subprocess.Popen launch in _stream_archive so a launch OSError converts to SnapshotError (or soften the 'every failure shape' claim).
evidence: src/rebar/llm/workflow/snapshot.py:243: `proc = subprocess.Popen(  # raw-git-ok...` sits before the `try:`/`finally:` at line 264-269
src/rebar/llm/workflow/snapshot.py:235-240 docstring implies full failure containment; _extract_stream's comment 'converting every failure shape' at line 280 only applies once Popen has succeeded
ABSENCE: no except around the Popen call in _stream_archive to convert a launch OSError into SnapshotError
advisory.finding: A subprocess.Popen launch failure (e.g. git absent from PATH raising FileNotFoundError/OSError) is raised before the try/finally in _stream_archive and is never wrapped in SnapshotError, so it escapes as a raw OSError — contradicting the docstring's claim that every failure shape converts to SnapshotError.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Restore the resolved SHA into the non-timeout 'git archive failed' SnapshotError message.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/workflow/snapshot.py:288-289: `stderr = ...` then `return SnapshotError(f"git archive failed: {stderr or detail}")`
_extract_stream does not receive `sha`; only `argv` (used solely on the timeout branch via _redact_cmd)
advisory.finding: The non-timeout failure message lost the sha context that the pre-fix code included ('git archive <sha[:12]> failed: ...'); _fail now emits only 'git archive failed: ...', a diagnostics regression.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Route the captured child stderr through `_redact_cmd` before interpolating it into the SnapshotError in `_extract_stream._fail()`.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/workflow/snapshot.py:288-289: `stderr = b"".join(captured).decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()` then `return SnapshotError(f"git archive failed: {stderr or detail}")`
The redactor is applied to argv/exc.cmd/detail (lines 286, 303, 306) but the `stderr` string is emitted raw and takes precedence via `stderr or detail`

Module docstring / design: `_redact_cmd` exists precisely because a credential-bearing URL must not survive into an error message (lines 64-80); git archive reaches the network through the promisor lazy-fetch path (comment at line 55-56 and stall_abort_args splice at line 242), so git's stderr can carry `fatal: unable to access 'https://user:token@host/...'`
advisory.finding: The non-timeout failure branch of _extract_stream._fail() interpolates the child's raw stderr into the SnapshotError message without passing it through _redact_cmd, so a `git archive` transport failure over the promisor lazy-fetch path (whose stderr can contain a `https://user:token@host/...` URL) leaks credentials into the error — reintroducing the exact 77e1 disclosure shape the redactor was added to prevent.
scenarios: A partial clone whose promisor remote is configured with an embedded-credential URL fails during `git archive`'s lazy fetch; git writes `fatal: unable to access 'https://bot:token@host/repo.git/'` to stderr, which is captured and surfaced verbatim in `git archive failed: ...`.
The SnapshotError message is logged or shown to a caller, disclosing the token.
advisory.suggested_fix: In `_fail`, redact the decoded stderr: `stderr = _redact_cmd(b"".join(captured).decode("utf-8", "replace").strip())` (and likewise for `detail` fallback) before building the SnapshotError message.

blocking.finding: bugfix-size-attestation: this change touches 188 non-test line(s) — over the 150-line floor for a bug fix — but bug 093a-4542-0fc9-46f5 has no acceptable plan-review attestation (verdict: unsigned; no plan-review attestation record). A fix this large is a design change wearing a bug label: write the fix plan into the ticket's description, run `rebar review-plan 093a-4542-0fc9-46f5` (it auto-escalates a bug with non-test file impact to the full review and SIGNS an attestation on a PASS; if the review passed but no attestation landed, `rebar sign-review 093a-4542-0fc9-46f5` re-persists it cheaply, and `rebar review-plan 093a-4542-0fc9-46f5 --status` confirms it is current without an LLM call), then re-push.
